capabilities.name: ASK_USER
capabilities.purpose: Request a user clarification that is necessary or useful to proceed safely.
capabilities.inputSchema: question, optional relatedFields
capabilities.resultMeaning: The task waits for a new user message; no state constraint is changed.
importantConstraints: Do not claim a booking or availability result.

capabilities.name: SEARCH_RESTAURANTS
capabilities.purpose: Discover matching restaurant outlets.
capabilities.inputSchema: optional retrievalHint; the router binds authoritative intent
capabilities.resultMeaning: Returns RestaurantCandidate records only, without availability claims.
importantConstraints: Cannot modify, repeat, or loosen authoritative user constraints.

capabilities.name: INVESTIGATE_CANDIDATE_FACTS
capabilities.purpose: Read source-supported restaurant facts needed by the current request for known candidates.
capabilities.inputSchema: candidateIds; the router binds candidates and authoritative request conditions
capabilities.resultMeaning: Returns candidate-associated source facts or an explicit unknown result; it never asserts availability.
importantConstraints: Only known candidates are valid; at most three candidates per bounded read; it does not itself claim a slot.

capabilities.name: CHECK_AVAILABILITY
capabilities.purpose: Read request-bound availability and any source-supported restaurant facts returned with it.
capabilities.inputSchema: candidateIds; the router binds authoritative date, time window, and party size
capabilities.resultMeaning: Returns fresh AvailabilityOffer records associated with candidate IDs.
importantConstraints: Only known candidates are valid; schedule values are never Agent-supplied; at most three unchecked candidates per read batch.

capabilities.name: END_READ
capabilities.purpose: End a bounded read-only investigation when its recorded scope has no grounded result to present.
capabilities.inputSchema: no business fields; optional short decision summary is trajectory-only
capabilities.resultMeaning: Writes a scoped NO_VERIFIED_RESULT outcome from authoritative investigation records, never a global negative claim.
importantConstraints: Only code may allow this after actual investigation; it cannot hide an internal failure, pending refresh, or grounded candidate.

capabilities.name: PRESENT_RESULTS
capabilities.purpose: Pause a read-only selection session with candidates whose required facts and availability are grounded.
capabilities.inputSchema: candidateIds; validator derives the required evidence from authoritative State
capabilities.resultMeaning: Writes an evidence-grounded result batch and waits for explicit user continuation; it does not select, authorize, or submit a booking.
importantConstraints: Every task-critical fact, including each HARD criterion and availability, must have current trusted evidence.

capabilities.name: SELECT_CANDIDATE
capabilities.purpose: Choose a discovered candidate and optionally its known offer for a possible booking proposal.
capabilities.inputSchema: candidateId, optional offerId
capabilities.resultMeaning: Records the selection; it does not authorize or submit a booking.
importantConstraints: A selected offer must belong to the selected candidate.

capabilities.name: BOOK_RESERVATION
capabilities.purpose: Request a booking proposal for one selected fresh offer.
capabilities.inputSchema: candidateId, offerId
capabilities.resultMeaning: Creates a deterministic ActionProposal and waits for valid user authorization.
importantConstraints: Cannot authorize, commit, or claim success.

Bamboo Course with All-You-Can-Drink: Enjoy Miyazaki's Specialty Black Grilled Chicken, Fukuoka's Specialty Sesame Mackerel, and Hakata Mentaiko Rice Bowl (8 Dishes) JPY 6,0008 items

Take | Seasonal Delights A course crafted with the finest ingredients of the day. Enjoy a satisfying yet relaxed dining experience that offers a touch of luxury in your everyday life. This course is also perfect for gatherings and meetings. For an additional JPY 800 per person, upgrade to our premium all-you-can-drink option featuring Kyushu's shochu and local sake. In addition to the standard all-you-can-drink selection, we offer authentic shochu such as Mitake, Daiyame, and Kicchou Hozan, as well as Japanese sake like Mitsui no Kotobuki, Tanaka Rokugo, and Shichida. Pair your drinks with horse sashimi, sesame mackerel, or hot pot, and enjoy your favorite choice. *Please note that the brands may vary based on availability.

ReserveSet menu details
JPY6,000（Price including tax）per person
Number of people
2 - 30

Dontaku Specialty All-You-Can-Drink Course with Mizutaki Wagyu Motsunabe9 items

Experience the traditional taste of Mizutaki Wagyu Motsunabe, a beloved dish that has been cherished in Fukuoka for 40 years. Don't miss out on this timeless flavor that has remained unchanged since our establishment. For an additional JPY 800 per person, enjoy our premium all-you-can-drink option featuring Kyushu's finest shochu and sake. In addition to our regular drink selection, we offer authentic shochu brands such as Mitake, Daiyame, and Kicchou Hozan, as well as Japanese sake like Mitsui no Kotobuki, Tanaka Rokugo, and Shichida. Pair your drinks with delicious dishes like horse sashimi, sesame mackerel, and motsunabe to find your perfect match. *Please note that the brands may vary based on availability.

Enjoy seasonal flavors with Akari's "Ultimate Luxury" Course. *For details, please check the course content. It's a proud lineup!! 【All you can drink for 3 hours is also available!】10 items

Indulge in a luxurious course at Akari, featuring seasonal delicacies! 【Each dish, except for the main course, is served individually】 Enjoy popular items such as the "Seasonal Assorted O-banzai Platter," the "Assorted Sashimi with Fresh Sea Urchin and Nodoguro (Blackthroat Sea Perch)," the "Grilled Nagoya Cochin Chicken," and the "Signature Clay Pot Rice" as the main dish. We have prepared a selection of Akari's renowned and popular dishes for your enjoyment. For an additional JPY 2,000, you can add a three-hour all-you-can-drink option! For JPY 3,000 more, upgrade to our "Premium All-You-Can-Drink" option, featuring about 20 types of Japanese sake such as "Nabeshima," "Isojiman," and "Bakuren," along with 16 types of shochu and 13 types of umeshu.

This course is perfect for gatherings with close friends, family meals, or business dinners, and is available for a full three hours. Enjoy seasonal flavors with Akari's "Ultimate Luxury" Course. *For details, please check the course content. It's a proud lineup!! 【All you can drink for 3 hours is also available!】10 items

Indulge in a luxurious course at Akari, featuring seasonal delicacies! 【Each dish, except for the main course, is served individually】 Enjoy popular items such as the "Seasonal Assorted O-banzai Platter," the "Assorted Sashimi with Fresh Sea Urchin and Nodoguro (Blackthroat Sea Perch)," the "Grilled Nagoya Cochin Chicken," and the "Signature Clay Pot Rice" as the main dish. We have prepared a selection of Akari's renowned and popular dishes for your enjoyment. For an additional JPY 2,000, you can add a three-hour all-you-can-drink option! For JPY 3,000 more, upgrade to our "Premium All-You-Can-Drink" option, featuring about 20 types of Japanese sake such as "Nabeshima," "Isojiman," and "Bakuren," along with 16 types of shochu and 13 types of umeshu.

listedCourseDetails: Enjoy seasonal flavors with Akari's "Ultimate Luxury" Course. *For details, please check the course content. It's a proud lineup!! 【All you can drink for 3 hours is also available!】 — JPY 6,000 （Price including tax）per person; Number of people 2 - 6. Indulge in a luxurious course at Akari, featuring seasonal delicacies! 【Each dish, except for the main course, is served individually】 Enjoy popular items such as the "Seasonal Assorted O-banzai Platter," the "Assorted Sashimi with Fresh Sea Urchin and Nodoguro (Blackthroat Sea Perch)," the "Grilled Nagoya Cochin Chicken," and the "Signature Clay Pot Rice" as the main dish. We have prepared a selection of Akari's renowned and popular dishes for your enjoyment. For an additional JPY 2,000, you can add a three-hour all-you-can-drink option! For JPY 3,000 more, upgrade to our "Premium All-You-Can-Drink" option, featuring about 20 types of Japanese sake such as "Nabeshima," "Isojiman," and "Bakuren," along with 16 types of shochu and 13 types of umeshu.

Akari's Classic Course with a Variety of Signature Dishes ◎【Add All You Can Drink for 2.5 Hours Available!】 — JPY 4,500 （Price including tax）per person; Number of people 2 - 6. Enjoy our recommended course featuring a delightful selection of dishes from "Akari"! 【All dishes, except for the main course, are served individually for each guest】 We offer a luxurious assortment of Akari's specialties, including the popular "Assorted O-banzai (5 items)" and "Assorted Sashimi with Nodoguro (5 items)". This course is perfect for gatherings with close friends, family meals, or business dinners, and is available for a full three hours. For an additional JPY 2,000, you can add a 2.5-hour standard all-you-can-drink option! For JPY 3,000 more, you can upgrade to our "Premium All-You-Can-Drink" option, featuring around 20 types of Japanese sake such as Nabeshima, Isojiman, and Bakuren, along with 16 types of shochu and 13 types of umeshu!
